IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 300490 (pharmaceuticals) does not match any observed shipment line — actual codes are cosmetics/soap 34011941, 34011190, 33049990, sanitary napkins 96190010 and toothbrush 96032100. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes (cosmetics/personal-care, mainly 3304/3401), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is also wrong — Vestige is a direct-selling health & wellness / personal-care company (own site title: 'Vestige - World Class Health & Wellness Product | Top Leading Direct Selling Company'). Domestic supply: DuckDuckGo search backend was down ('Connection refused') for all queries, tofler.in returned HTTP 403 and vestige.com/about-us returned 404, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved — recorded as unknown/null rather than guessed.
